profile_text.body:
RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. is listed as a public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the ticker RR and CIK 0001963685. The website recorded for it is rolls-royce.com, and the text gathered from that site describes Rolls-Royce rather than a robotics business.

According to that site, Rolls-Royce describes itself as pioneering technologies that deliver clean, safe and competitive solutions for power needs, and says it has been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years. It states that it develops and delivers complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land. The site reports the completion of a $1 Billion investment in Indiana, describing Indianapolis as an engine manufacturing and test campus. It also notes a strategic intent between Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce to partner on India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, co-operation between Rolls-Royce, the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies, and multiple contractual commitments by Rolls-Royce SMR to deliver SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group.

The held facts record no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for this company, and a Nevada law exposure count of zero. Nothing in the harvested site text describes AI products or an AI position.
